items.title: Why Is Costco (COST) Refunding Tariff Duties While Fighting A Class Action?
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (NasdaqGS:COST) has begun refunding customers for unlawful duties collected on certain tariffed goods. The company is contesting a related class action lawsuit that challenges how those tariff related charges were handled. The refunds and legal dispute raise questions about future liabilities, customer relationships, and Costco's brand image. This kind of tariff and legal exposure is not unique to Costco.
